/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime.name: Venari Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime.description: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime.descriptionEn: Khora's will, Venari's fangs and claws.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraPrime.descriptionZh: Khora 的意志，薇娜丽的尖牙利爪。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat.name: Venari
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat.description: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat.descriptionEn: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Kavat/KhoraKavat.descriptionZh: Khora 忠诚的库娃。她永远的同伴和守护者。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Wyrm
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「突击模式」和「群体击散」为预设指令，是强力进攻型的守护，并同时具备激光步枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Taxon
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「突击模式」和「分子转化」为预设指令，塔克桑利用护盾恢复来保护主人。它装备了阿塔克斯冰冷光束。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Shade
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「复仇」和「幽灵」为预设指令，非常适合隐匿型玩法，并同时具备点放式激光手枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Oxylus
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「扫描水生生命体」和「扫描物质」为默认指令，奥克绪罗斯被设计用于奥布山谷外围严酷环境的搜救行动。奥克绪罗斯拥有一把多连穿甲枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Prisma Shade
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 虚空中的一种稀有珍宝。怎有如此美丽宝物竟是为潜行锻造？

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Wyrm Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 保镖与地位的象征，在奥罗金时代中，蛟龙守护 Prime 是高阶Tenno 的最后一道防线。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Shade Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 阴影 Prime 专长隐形，它装载了激光点发 Prime。和它一同主宰暗影吧。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Helios Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 这个充满求知欲的守护与分离 Prime 一同防卫着它们的主人。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Dethcube Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」作为预设指令，死亡魔方 Prime 是致命支援的巅峰。其标配武器为死亡机枪 Prime。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Carrier Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 这架华丽的守护是呈现奥罗金晚期工艺与风格极佳的范例。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Nautilus Prime
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: （英文：NAUTILUS PRIME）这位勇敢的水手使用冰凇 Prime 来保护他的船员。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Helios
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 赫利俄斯拥有独特的「侦查」指令并以「分离」作为武器，这位多功能的守护既是致命的守护者，又是资料库的自动扫描器。扫描功能须在身上携带扫描器，且扫描器有可使用的扫描次数才能触发。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Djinn
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「重击者」和「致命诱惑」为预设指令，引灵是一个战斗守护，还配备了毒镖武器。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Nautilus
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「万用自修」和「防线封锁」为默认指令，这件守护是搭乘航道星舰远航的理想同伴。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Dethcube
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Carrier
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 以「突击模式」和「弹药储转箱」为预设指令，搬运者是一个前锋守护，并配备一把霰弹枪。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.name: Diriga
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.description: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionEn: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelPowersuit.descriptionZh: 电气浮囊会电击附近的敌人，并针对远处的威胁目标进行攻击。使用「金工火枪」狙击步枪与「精算射击」、「电弧线圈」与「电光脉冲」等独特技能。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub.name: Chesa Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub.description: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub.descriptionEn: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/RetrieverKub.descriptionZh: 一个聪明的伙伴，经过训练可以从敌人手中夺取武器和战利品。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow.name: Sunika Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow.description: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow.descriptionEn: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/HunterKubrow.descriptionZh: 由奥罗金培育，用于战斗。这头武术野兽的使命是制造混乱，击倒最凶猛的对手。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP.name: Raksa Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP.description: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP.descriptionEn: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/GuardKubrowP.descriptionZh: 强大的守护者，专注于通过加强防御和驱赶攻击者来保护其主人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro.name: Huras Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro.description: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro.descriptionEn: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/FurtiveKubro.descriptionZh: 一个隐秘的伙伴，以惊人的爆炸力量出其不意地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro.name: Helminth Charger
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro.description: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro.descriptionEn: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/ChargerKubro.descriptionZh: 库狛与感染者的实验性混合体。可使用蛆虫和其他感染者的能力造成伤害并控制战场。

/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu.name: Sahasa Kubrow
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu.description: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu.descriptionEn: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.
/Lotus/Types/Game/KubrowPet/AdventurerKu.descriptionZh: 一个可靠的伙伴，为他们的 Tenno 主人找到补给并削弱敌人的力量。

/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb.name: Vasca Kavat
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb.description: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb.descriptionEn: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/VampireCatb.descriptionZh: 现在，这些库娃已经摆脱了噬血病毒，它们可以通过输送生命来延长自己的生命值，同时也可以延长主人的生命值。

/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr.name: Adarza Kavat
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr.description: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr.descriptionEn: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/MirrorCatbr.descriptionZh: 凶猛而致命的库娃因其战斗力而备受推崇，它能增加暴击几率并惩罚那些胆敢攻击它的人。

/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat.name: Smeeta Kavat
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat.description: This sly feline is playful yet devious.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat.descriptionEn: This sly feline is playful yet devious.
/Lotus/Types/Game/CatbrowPet/CheshireCat.descriptionZh: 这只狡猾的猫既好玩又诡诈。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Sly Vulpaphyla
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionEn: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionZh: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Vizier Predasite
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionEn: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionZh: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Pharaoh Predasite
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionEn: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionZh: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Medjay Predasite
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionEn: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionZh: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Crescent Vulpaphyla
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionEn: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.name: Panzer Vulpaphyla
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.description: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/CreaturePets/.descriptionEn: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MoaPetItem
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.descriptionEn: MOAs are versatile robotic allies that specialize in indirect support both in and outside of combat.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/MoaPets/MoaPe.descriptionZh: 恐鸟是多功能的机器人盟友，擅长在战斗内外提供间接支援。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/ZanukaPets/Za.name: /Lotus/Language/Pets/ZanukaPetItemName
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/ZanukaPets/Za.descriptionEn: Hounds are powerful robotic companions optimized for combat. They are programmed to excel at battlefield control and can be configured for countless scenarios.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/ZanukaPets/Za.descriptionZh: 猎犬是专为战斗而优化的强大机械伙伴。它们经过编程，擅长在战场上控制局势，并可根据无数场景进行配置。

/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/ZanukaPets/Za.name: /Lotus/Language/Pets/ZanukaPetItemName
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/ZanukaPets/Za.descriptionEn: Hounds are powerful robotic companions optimized for combat. They are programmed to excel at battlefield control and can be configured for countless scenarios.
/Lotus/Types/Friendly/Pets/ZanukaPets/Za.descriptionZh: 猎犬是专为战斗而优化的强大机械伙伴。它们经过编程，擅长在战场上控制局势，并可根据无数场景进行配置。
